## F — Structured research index

Open verification debts for this section: none. Every icy danger spots, dawn and dusk glare, night driving precautions, freeway planning, entering, driving, emergency stops and exiting, and the emergency procedures for blowouts, lost wheels, brake and steering failure, wheels off the pavement, passing conflicts, oncoming vehicles, a stuck accelerator, skids, fire and breakdowns claim in parts C and C-two carries a page-bound anchor, and part D raised no accuracy flag.

Exam facts recorded as unknown (question count, passing standard, time limit, format) are terminal unknown states from part A, not open debts; they need no VERIFY entry.

Market and teardown scope statements live in parts E and E-two; audience and exam-authority context live in parts B and A.

Consolidated VERIFY list: empty for this section. The interleaved bullets on the fourth page are recorded as a source-form caution in part D, not as an open debt, because the page states each step plainly.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the icy danger spots, dawn and dusk glare, night driving precautions, freeway planning, entering, driving, emergency stops and exiting, and the emergency procedures for blowouts, lost wheels, brake and steering failure, wheels off the pavement, passing conflicts, oncoming vehicles, a stuck accelerator, skids, fire and breakdowns rules on pages 77–84 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
